Coram : R. SUBHASH REDDY*, HRISHIKESH ROY
Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 – Termination – Suit before civil court – Maintainability of – Held: Civil court lacks jurisdiction to entertain a suit structured on the provisions of the ID Act – Thus, in the present case the decree favouring the appellant-employee is Finding of the High Court to this extent, upheld – However, considering the hardship to the appellant, the arrear paid pursuant to the court’s decree not to be recovered. Dismissing the appeal, the Court Held: 1.1 The civil courts may have the limited jurisdiction in service matters,
Decision Date : 08-10-2021 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1346/2010 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
